evidence.notes: Typed query and binds with SYSTEM_MODE return the matching row in deployable Apex test context.
Inline SOQL with SYSTEM_MODE produces an iterable QueryLocator in deployable Apex test context.

source.content: @isTest private class DBQueryLocatorModesModeTest { @isTest static void queriesRunInSystemMode() { insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Hot Account', Rating = 'Hot'), new Account(Name = 'Warm Account', Rating = 'Warm')}; Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'rating' => 'Warm'}; List<Account> warmRows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, warmRows.size()); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator([SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Hot Account'], AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); Iterator<SObject> iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Hot Account', ((Account)iterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); } }
